run_video_jepa_training: run the video JEPA training script on Moving MNIST with a YAML config file and optional overrides
run_training_with_custom_config: run the video JEPA training with a custom config file path and dot notation overrides
run_training_with_checkpoint: run the video JEPA training resuming from a saved checkpoint using the load_model config option
run_training_with_experiment_folder: run the video JEPA training with a specific experiment folder path for output artifacts
run_training_with_wandb_logging: run the video JEPA training with Weights and Biases logging enabled via the config file
